layout_map:
1. Top bar — full-width header strip; left chip "Example-3", centered red title "Radial Basis Function (RBF) Kernel", right math formula [e⁻ᵞ||a-b||²] and yellow "23" slide pill.
2. Top-left source card — small rounded box at upper-left showing column vectors [a₁ b₁; a₂ b₂].
3. Top-right "Normal Model" pane — large light-blue rounded box upper-right; header "Normal Model / Calculate aᵀb", inner vector pair [a₁ a₂; b₁ b₂], red exit arrow at right edge.
4. Middle header band — "Map Input data from 2D to infinite Dimension" spanning between the top and bottom rows.
5. Bottom-left flow cluster — left vector box, red hatch arrow into the red-bordered "Vectors Mapping e⁻ᵞ||a-b||² a,b → u,v" pill, red hatch arrow into tall matrix column [u₁ v₁ … u∞ v∞], with purple "Higher Computational Complexity !!!" chip below-left.
6. Bottom-right "Kernelized Model" pane — large green rounded box lower-right; header "Kernelized Model / Calculate uᵀv", inner wide matrix [u₁ u₂ u₃ … u∞; v₁ v₂ v₃ … v∞], purple "Higher Computational Complexity !!!" chip bottom-left inside, red exit arrow at right.
7. Overall canvas — light-gray rounded slide surface with thin red outer border.
8. Page-number pill — top-right corner, yellow circle with "23".
first_glance_test: A new user understands within 3 seconds that this is a lecture slide about the RBF kernel, showing 2D vectors mapped to infinite dimension and then to a kernelized model — the red title, formula, and two color-coded model panes carry that instantly. The screen offers no interactive actions (it is a static lecture frame); the only "actions" are the red flow arrows indicating sequence. Given the injected VIEW purpose (a lecture frame), the focal point should be the RBF title and the Normal-versus-Kernelized model contrast, and it does win the eye via the large red centered title and the two dominant right-hand panes.
strengths: The left-to-right red hatch-arrow flow gives an immediately readable process sequence across the slide.
Color coding is effective: light-blue "Normal Model" pane versus green "Kernelized Model" pane clearly separates the two concepts.
The title and formula are large, high-contrast, and centered, so the topic is legible at a glance.

defects.description: overall slide — full canvas — light-mode near-white surface stack with dark text — conflicts with the app's stated dark-themed surface stack — restyle to dark theme or treat as intentional projection exception.
middle header band — center — "infinite Dimension" capitalizes "Dimension" mid-phrase — breaks sentence case against the rest of the line — lowercase "dimension".

bottom-left flow cluster & Kernelized Model pane — below vectors-mapping pill / inside green pane — identical "Higher Computational Complexity !!!" chip rendered twice — copy duplication across sibling regions — keep one instance or consolidate into a single span callout.
purple complexity chips — bottom-left and inside Kernelized Model — triple exclamation "!!!" — shouty/informal tone for lecture copy — single exclamation or rephrase.

top_3: Light-mode slide inside a stated dark-themed app — biggest perceived-quality blemish (§4 defect under (a)).
Duplicated "Higher Computational Complexity !!!" chip across two regions — copy redundancy (§4 defect under (o)).
"infinite Dimension" mid-phrase capitalization — copy-polish lapse (§4 defect under (b)).
